- Identify the visible faces of the IV from the current viewpoint [S1, book].

The claim states that the evidence supports the identification of visible faces of the IV from the current viewpoint. Source [S1], specifically in Section 4.2, explicitly states: 'The viewpoint entropy for the IV can be calculated using Equation (1) by identifying the visible faces of the IV.' This confirms that the method involves identifying visible faces (and treating occluded ones as background) to calculate entropy, which aligns with the claim.
